title: Roads of the Roman Empire: how many days from Rome to anywhere?
excerpt: Itiner-e, the new open map of Roman roads, holds 299,171 km of road. Only 2.7% is certain. Walked in a model, London is 81 days from Rome, Alexandria 180, and by road alone Carthage is further than either.
seo_description: A map of every Roman road in Itiner-e, and a travel model of how many days it took to walk, ride or send a letter from Rome to anywhere.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Roads of the Roman Empire' in black on cream, beside a map of the Mediterranean with every Roman road coloured by days on foot from Rome, from deep red in Italy through gold, green and teal to violet in North Africa. Text: 299,171 km of road; London 81 days on foot, Constantinople 75, Alexandria 180.
